description: I took an oath to defend the Tennessee Constitution, and I take that oath seriously. This session, the 114th General Assembly passed important legislation to strengthen constitutional governance, protect individual rights, and push back against overreach from both Washington and international organizations.We passed the Regulatory Freedom Act, which requires government agencies to be transparent and accountable when they adopt new rules that impose costs on the private sector.
